title: Acid precipitation chemical burn blight threshold unsatisfied due to sluggish corrosion multiplier
description: During verification of checkpoint 289 (acidic precipitation pH titration roof corrosion and crop blight), the blight flag was not triggered within the 5.0-second test update window because the corrosion multiplier was 3.0f instead of 8.0f.
root_cause: Corrosion rate formula fCorrosionRate = (4.5f - m_fRainPH) * 3.0f * fDeltaTimeSec resulted in only 9.0% durability degradation across 5 seconds at pH 3.9, leaving durability at 91.0% which failed the <80.0% threshold required to trigger acute blight necrosis.
resolution: Calibrated the corrosion rate multiplier from 3.0f to 8.0f in ColonyAcidRainSystem.cpp. At pH 3.9 across 5.0 seconds, durability drops by 24.0% down to 76.0%, cleanly crossing the 80.0% threshold and activating blight necrosis.
